cards.audioText: [Your call sign is BAW038, from Beijing to London, passing 1200m climbing to 1800m, now contact Beijing Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是英航038，飞机从北京飞往伦敦，通过1200米，正在上升至1800米，现在联系北京离场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, passing 1200m climbing to 1800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，英航038，通过1200米，正上升至1800米。

cards.audioText: BAW038, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，北京离场，雷达已识别，上升到标准气压6000米。
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升到标准气压6000米，英航038。

cards.audioText: [The aircraft ingested something, request descent to 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机吸入了某些东西，请求下降到3000米。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, foreign object ingestion, request descent to 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，英航038，飞机吸入异物，请求下降到3000米。

cards.audioText: BAW038, roger, descend to 3000m on QNH 1011.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，收到，下降到3000米，修正海压1011。
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到3000米，修正海压1011，英航038。

cards.audioText: BAW038, Beijing Departure, report intention.[Your turbine blades appear to be broken, request return to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，北京离场，报告意图。【你的涡轮叶片似乎破损了，请求返回北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request return to Beijing airport, our turbine blades may have been broken, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求返回北京机场，涡轮叶片可能已破损，英航038。

cards.audioText: BAW038, roger, turn right heading 180, information I, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，收到，右转航向180，通播I，雷达引导着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, information I, radar vector for landing, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，通播I，雷达引导着陆，英航038。

cards.audioText: BAW038, report current situation.[Tell the controller that the port engine flamed out and you should land as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，报告现在的情况。【告诉管制员左发熄火了，你需要尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Beijing Departure, BAW038, port engine flames out, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, 北京离场，英航038，左发动机熄火，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: BAW038 roger, can you execute normal landing, do you require fuel dumping?[You can land normally and no need for fuel dumping.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，收到，能否执行正常着陆，需要放油吗？【飞机可以正常着陆，不需要放油。】
cards.referenceText: We can make a normal landing without dumping fuel, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以正常着陆不需要放油，英航038。

cards.audioText: [2 minutes later.][Tell the controller the fuel passage is blocked, only the auxiliary fuel tank is available, request priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【2分钟后】【告诉管制员燃油管道被堵住了，只有备用油箱可以使用，请求优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, fuel passage blocked by a foreign object, now only the auxiliary fuel tank is operative, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，英航038，燃油管道被异物堵住，现在只有备用油箱可用，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: BAW038, Beijing roger, report endurance.[Tell Control that your endurance is 30 minutes.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，北京收到，报告续航时间。【告诉管制员你的续航时间是30分钟。】

cards.audioText: BAW038, roger, turn right heading 300, expect runway 01, caution surface wind 240, 12m/s, gusting to 18m/s.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，收到，右转航向300，预计跑道01，注意地面风240, 12米/秒，阵风18米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, expect runway 01, roger, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300，预计跑道01，收到，英航038。

cards.audioText: BAW038, turn right heading 340, report established localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，右转航向340，建立航向道后报。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, report established localizer, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向340，建立航向道后报，英航038。
北京进场，英航038，已建立航向道。

cards.audioText: BAW038, continue approach, contact Beijing Tower 118.1, I will advise them of your problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1，我会通知他们你的情况。

cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，英航038，建立盲降。

cards.audioText: BAW038, Beijing Tower, continue approach, report outer marker, caution surface wind 240, 12m/s, gusting to 18m/s.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，北京塔台，继续进近，过远台报告，注意地面风240, 12米/秒，阵风18米/秒。

cards.audioText: BAW038, cleared to land runway 01, wind 240, 12m/s, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，可以着陆跑道01，风向240, 风速12米/秒，脱离跑道后报。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 01, report vacated, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆跑道01，脱离后报，英航038。
